Selected UX and interface work from my 2015–16 portfolio at EY.

SharePoint sites, internal tools, and tablet concepts. Original artifacts, presented with the context the deck provides.

07 projects17 original imagesExplore the work
01 / SharePoint / Calendar

Global 360

A calendar experience for Global Markets events.

The 2015–16 portfolio describes a heuristic evaluation of an existing application and a move toward a more minimal design. The work included low- and high-fidelity interactive wireframes for browsing events, opening event details, and registration.

02 / SharePoint / Intranet

EY GDN Pulse

An intranet home for Global Delivery Network information.

The brief was to conceptualize a new set of pages for a SharePoint site serving the GDNs. The original portfolio records low- and high-fidelity interactive wireframes.

03 / SharePoint / Internal tools

Global Real Estate

A SharePoint site for frequently used tools and upcoming events.

The original portfolio describes a heuristic evaluation of the existing site followed by low- and high-fidelity interactive wireframes for the Global Real Estate team.

04 / iPad app

EY PVSC

A tablet experience for the Public Value Score Card.

These original presentation images show the PVSC home experience and a related iPad screen. The deck does not document a research process or measured outcome for this work.

05 / iPad app

Total Supplier Reliability

Tablet screens for a supplier reliability experience.

The portfolio shows three views of the TSR iPad interface. They are presented here as visual artifacts, without claiming a shipped product or measured impact.

06 / iPad app

EY Beam

A task-oriented tablet interface.

The slides show a schedule of work, a project creation form, and a project detail view. The source deck includes no process or outcome notes for this concept.

07 / Prototype

Digital Dashboard

An early dashboard prototype.

A single slide presents a tablet dashboard concept with performance charts. It is labeled as prototyping in the original deck.

ABOUT THIS ARCHIVE

Images were extracted from my 2015–16 portfolio presentation. Some screens contain placeholder content and example data. The deck documents UX activities for the three SharePoint projects; the tablet work is shown primarily through screens. This page does not imply that every concept shipped or produced measured results.
